# Kuber Bassi (KUβER βΔSSI)

> Official portfolio of Kuber Bassi (stylized as **KUβER βΔSSI** for music releases), an independent software engineer and music producer based in New Delhi, India. The site presents his software projects, engineering toolkit, working principles, original music discography, and official contact links.

## Main Website

- [Portfolio](https://kuberbassi.com/): Official portfolio, selected work, toolkit, music, and contact information.
- [Complete Site Summary](https://kuberbassi.com/llms-full.txt): Consolidated plain-text overview of the portfolio and full music discography.

## Identity & Aliases

- **Legal / Professional Name:** Kuber Bassi
